name: codex-game-maker
description: A lean Codex game-making workflow for Godot-first games, game-ready GPT Image 2D assets, production planning, and QA gates.

interface.longDescription: A lean game development operating system for Codex: guided concept design, Godot-first engine detection, art bible, game-ready GPT Image 2 sprite/map asset pipeline, architecture templates, and review/QA gates.
defaultPrompt: Start a new Godot-first game project with Codex Game Maker.
Turn this game idea into a concept doc, art bible, and first asset prompts.
Create game-ready 2D sprite assets with transparent frames, GIF preview, metadata, and Godot import notes.
Audit this existing project and tell me which engine and stage it appears to be.
Review this game project and run a QA gate before demo/export.
